gate_type: D-DAY TRACK B — DDAY-B5 CORRECTION (COMPRESSOR ALARM THRESHOLD + TARGETED CLASSIFICATION + CONTROL RUN)
objective: Bounded correction of the three SA-verified DDAY-B5-C01 leftovers: (1) raise the compressor low-pressure alarm only after raw air pressure reaches/crosses one explicit warning threshold; (2) attach Compressor downtime/failure classification to the compressor abnormal event/context as optional post-event enrichment; (3) add a matched compressor-disabled control-run proof that abnormal-window good/FG is lower and recovery resumes toward the control cadence. Keep Capper frozen. Do not expand scenario fidelity.

conservative_interpretation.issue_109_live_read: Live Issue #109 could not be fetched (GitHub App token has no issues:read; GraphQL unresolved / REST 403). This contract is authored from the SA review comment on PR #101 (2026-10-04T06:17:46Z, CORRECTION REQUIRED at 3b9cc8c) plus the explicit user execution order, which name the same three leftovers.
conservative_interpretation.alarm_threshold: Add one explicit warning_threshold_bar. Phase LOW_PRESSURE_WARNING may enter first. ALARM_RAISED is emitted only when observed air_pressure <= warning_threshold_bar while the warning/undersupply window is active. Alarm still precedes UNDERSUPPLY on the default and short trajectories. Clear on RECOVERY if the alarm was raised.
conservative_interpretation.classification: Smallest targeted classify(kind, code, target=...) seam. target compressor / BW-UT-CMP01 / BW-CMP-SAG-01 stores codes on the compressor helper and stamps ALARM_RAISED/CLEARED plus LOW_PRESSURE_WARNING/UNDERSUPPLY phase events. Default target remains Capper so existing Capper classify tests stay valid. Codes never change pressure, phase, or production.
conservative_interpretation.control_run: Matched pair: same line, Capper disabled, compressor enabled vs compressor disabled, same simulated duration. Abnormal-window counts/good/FG are lower under UNDERSUPPLY; after RECOVERY the abnormal run resumes producing toward the control cadence.
conservative_interpretation.capper: Do not modify capper_degradation.py / capper_degradation.contract.yaml / capper_degradation.runtime.yaml / test_dday_b5_capper_scenario.py. Unchanged vs 3b9cc8c. Those files stay off forbidden_paths because they already exist in the PR-vs-main diff.
conservative_interpretation.fidelity: Do not add phases, physics, or a generic scenario framework. Keep default phase durations and pressure fall/rise rates.
